# Box Style Theorem Example

::: {.box .theorem-box}
::: {.title}
Theorem (Lipschitz Gradient Descent Step)
:::
::: {.content}
Let $f: \setR^n \rightarrow \setR$ be differentiable with $L$-Lipschitz gradient. Then for any $x, y \in \setR^n$,

$$
f(y) \le f(x) + \nabla f(x)^\top (y-x) + \frac{L}{2}\norm{y-x}^2.
$$

Choosing $y = x - \frac{1}{L}\nabla f(x)$ gives a guaranteed descent step.
:::
:::
